general.title: Discord Quest Helper
general.subtitle: Dashboard for managing your Discord Quests
general.login_prompt: Login with your Discord account to start managing your quests.

auth.cdp_login_hint: Use the Discord app you're already signed in to — no token needed.
auth.local_login_desc: Extract all signed-in account tokens from Discord's local database.
auth.cdp_login_detail: Use the account currently signed in to the Discord client. Discord must be running with CDP enabled.
auth.cdp_login_detail_vesktop: Use the account currently signed in to Vesktop. Vesktop must be running with CDP enabled.
auth.cdp_choose_desc: No client is running with CDP enabled. Choose which installed client to start.
auth.cdp_runtime_loading: Waiting for the client to load. Retry shortly.
auth.cdp_runtime_unavailable: Client runtime verification failed. Please retry.
auth.cdp_port_occupied: CDP port {port} is occupied by another service. Free the port or choose a different port.

progress.accounts_found: Found {count} valid account(s). Choose an account to continue.
progress.choose_client: Choose which Discord client to start with CDP...
progress.restart_required: Discord is already running and must be restarted with CDP enabled.
progress.restart_required_vesktop: Vesktop is already running and must be restarted with CDP enabled.
progress.restart_cancelled: Discord restart was cancelled. No account was logged in.
progress.launch_cancelled: Client launch was cancelled. No account was logged in.

home.dashboard_desc: Review quest status, then filter the list to take action.
home.exe_select_desc: {game} has multiple executables. Please select which one to simulate:
home.custom_exe_desc: {game} has no known executables in Discord's database. Please enter a custom process name to simulate.
home.empty_recommended: No immediate action needed. You can view all quests or refresh.
home.empty_ready_to_run: No accepted quests are ready to run.
home.empty_ready_to_claim: No completed quests are waiting for claim.
home.include_expired_desc: Show expired entries for inspection and recovery.
home.orbs_redeemed_unavailable: Unable to load redeemed total. Try refreshing.
home.orbs_airdrop_unavailable: Unable to load airdrop schedule. Try refreshing.
home.nitro_next_orbs_title: Monthly Nitro Orbs — next claim countdown
home.claim_navigated: Discord has been redirected to the quest page. Please claim your reward there.
home.activity_launch_desc: This quest requires launching a Discord Activity. The following steps will be performed:
home.activity_launch_step1: Navigate to the quest page in Discord
home.activity_launch_step2: Click 'Launch Quest' in Discord to open the Activity
home.activity_launch_step3: Complete any authorization prompts in Discord
home.activity_launch_step4: Return here and click 'Start Quest' to begin
home.activity_navigate_error: Failed to navigate Discord to quest page. Please open Discord manually and go to the Quests page.

quest.soft_error_win32_only: {game} only provides a Windows executable, which can't be process-simulated on Linux. Switch to CDP mode to complete this quest.
quest.soft_error_not_found: {game} has no compatible executable for simulation mode. Switch to CDP mode to complete this quest.

queue.order_hint: Drag cards or use the arrows to reorder tasks.
queue.stop_current_continue: Stop this task, then continue the remaining {count} queued tasks.
queue.stop_all_description: Stop processing and clear all {count} pending tasks.

settings.proton_wiresock_auto: If WireSock is missing, the app installs it with a UAC prompt and continues.
settings.proton_desc: Generate a WireGuard profile automatically with your ProtonVPN account. The bundled generator uses SRP and keeps the session local.
settings.proton_password_desc: The helper does not store it. It is sent to the local generator through stdin.
settings.proton_password_placeholder: Leave blank to use the saved session
settings.proton_countries_desc: Comma-separated two-letter codes. The generator picks the free server with the lowest load.
settings.proton_session_hint: After the first login, the generator saves a session file (.protonvpn-session.json) in your home folder. Leave the password blank for one-click reconnects.
settings.proton_2fa_hint: Accounts with 2FA: open the app data folder (LocalAppData/com.masterain.discord-quest-helper) and run proton-confgen --username YOUR-USERNAME once in a terminal to save a session; this app does not handle TOTP yet.
settings.proton_license_note: The bundled proton-confgen is GPL-3.0; its source is in tools/proton-confgen. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
settings.live_tunnel_exit_note: The tunnel stops when the helper closes.
settings.live_tunnel_desc: Route only Discord and its updater through a WireGuard tunnel. Use it where Live or screen sharing is unavailable.
settings.live_tunnel_config_desc: Import a .conf file from your VPN provider. It stays on this device and is not uploaded.
settings.live_tunnel_running: Tunnel active. Discord and its updater are routed through it.
settings.live_tunnel_stopped: Tunnel stopped. Select a configuration and start it.
settings.live_tunnel_external_running: WireSock is already running outside this app. Stop it there before starting the helper tunnel.
settings.live_tunnel_wiresock_missing: The WireSock CLI/SDK is not installed. Install it, then reopen this section.
settings.live_tunnel_restart_hint: After starting the tunnel, restart Discord from Discord integration so its processes use the new route.
settings.live_tunnel_restart_confirm_desc: Discord needs to restart so its processes use the tunnel route. The tunnel stays active if you skip this.
settings.live_tunnel_warning: This changes Discord network path and may add latency. Regional access may violate Discord terms; use it only where you are allowed to.
settings.title: Settings
settings.control_center_desc: Browse all settings below, or use the categories to jump to a section.
settings.recommend_account: Connect an account before managing quests.
settings.recommend_integration: Discord Client is not connected. CDP mode and Activity quests require it.
settings.account_desc: Connect the Discord account used for quests.
settings.advanced_login_desc: Manual token entry is available for recovery or unusual setups.
settings.token_storage_note: Tokens are stored locally by the app and should not be shared.
settings.quest_behavior_desc: Adjust quest timing and configure the game simulation directory.
settings.game_polling_hint: Polling interval for querying quest progress
settings.display_desc: Optional account-level information shown on the Home page.
settings.show_orbs_balance_desc: Fetches virtual currency balance on login and when manually refreshed.
settings.game_mode_simulate_desc: Starts a lightweight simulated game process.
settings.game_mode_cdp_desc: Injects into Discord client via CDP. Works for all games. Requires Discord with debug port enabled.
settings.game_mode_cdp_unavailable: CDP not available. Start Discord with --remote-debugging-port.
settings.simulation_directory_desc: Directory used to store executable and runtime files created for game process simulation.
settings.simulation_directory_resolve_error: Failed to resolve the default game simulation directory.
settings.simulation_directory_select_error: Failed to select the game simulation directory.
settings.simulation_directory_reset_error: Failed to restore the default game simulation directory.
settings.simulation_directory_open_error: Failed to open the game simulation directory.
settings.simulation_directory_copy_error: Failed to copy the game simulation directory.
settings.about_desc: A tool to help complete Discord quests automatically.
settings.about_warning: Warning: Using this tool may violate Discord's Terms of Service. Use at your own risk.
settings.check_prerelease_desc: Include pre-release versions when checking for updates.
settings.diagnostics_desc: Export application logs for troubleshooting issues.
settings.diagnostics_info: Logs are automatically sanitized to remove sensitive data like tokens and personal information. Only logs from this session are included.
settings.cdp_desc: Connect to the Discord client for accurate client data. Launch or restart Discord with CDP from here.
settings.cdp_disconnected: Not connected - Start Discord with debug flag
settings.cdp_sync: Sync Discord Client Info via CDP
settings.custom_port_desc: Keep the default unless Discord was launched with a different debug port.
settings.cdp_launch_desc: Start Discord with the CDP debugging port. If Discord is already running, a confirmation will be shown before restarting.
settings.cdp_dialog_desc_disconnected: Discord is running but CDP is not connected. We need to restart Discord with the CDP debug port enabled.
settings.cdp_dialog_desc_disconnected_vesktop: Vesktop is running but CDP is not connected. We need to restart Vesktop with the CDP debug port enabled.
settings.desktop_client_desc: When Discord and Vesktop are both installed, this choice only affects CDP login. Local token extraction always uses the official Discord client.
settings.cdp_dialog_desc_connected: Discord is already connected via CDP. Restarting will briefly disconnect and relaunch the client.
settings.cdp_shortcut_desc: Create a long-lived desktop shortcut that launches the current Discord version with CDP enabled.
settings.cdp_shortcut_success: CDP launcher shortcut created on Desktop
settings.client_emulation_desc: Current client identity used for API requests. Sync via CDP for the most accurate values.
settings.super_props_mode_desc: Advanced request identity source used by API calls.
settings.tooltip_cdp_3: Video quests run at real-time speed (server enforced)
settings.tooltip_simulate_1: Spawns a lightweight fake game process
settings.tooltip_heartbeat_3: No process simulation, but not recommended
settings.video_config_cdp_notice: These settings are not used in CDP mode. CDP mode sends progress directly via Discord's internal API.
settings.activity_cdp_required: Activity quests require CDP mode. Enable CDP in the Discord Client Integration section above.
settings.activity_timing_advanced_desc: Only adjust these values when activity quests need a different checkpoint cadence.
settings.advanced_desc: Implementation details for ports, developer mode, and legacy recovery.
settings.developer_mode_desc: Unlocked from the About section for debug tools.
settings.debug_unlock_hint: You are {steps} steps away from being a developer.
settings.disable_debug_confirm_desc: The Debug tab and developer tools will be hidden. You can re-enable it by tapping the version number 7 times.
settings.keep_alive_enabled: Keep the game connected after completion
settings.keep_alive_desc: After a simulated game quest completes, keep the game connected for a while before closing it. The queue advances only after this wait.
settings.keep_alive_simulate_only: Only applies to process-simulated quests; CDP quests drop their presence as soon as they complete.

version.update_desc: Version {version} is now available. You are currently on {current}.

game_sim.platform_capabilities_unavailable: Platform capabilities are unavailable. Restart the app and try again.
game_sim.title: Game Simulator
game_sim.select_game: Select a game from the list to start
game_sim.config_desc: Configure and run the simulated game.
game_sim.no_exe_hint: This game has no known executables in Discord's database. You can enter a custom process name to simulate.
game_sim.no_linux_exe_hint: This game only ships a Windows executable, which can't be process-simulated on Linux. You can enter a custom process name, or use CDP mode instead.
game_sim.no_exe_custom_warning: An incorrect process name may not be detected by Discord.
game_sim.custom_config_desc: Enter any executable name to simulate a custom process.
game_sim.custom_exe_hint: The process name Discord will detect. Include the extension on Windows (e.g. game.exe).
game_sim.create_dialog_desc: This will write a standalone simulated process executable to a folder on your disk. You can run it later independently of this app to trigger Discord game detection.
game_sim.run_success_rpc: Simulated game is running with RPC!
game_sim.cdp_active: Manual CDP simulation is active for {name}.
game_sim.cdp_session_restored: Restored the active CDP simulation for {name}.
game_sim.cdp_unavailable: Discord CDP is not connected. Start Discord with CDP enabled and try again.
game_sim.cdp_button_hint: Inject the selected game into Discord until you stop it manually.
game_sim.history_start_failed: Could not start simulation history: {error}. The simulation was rolled back.
game_sim.history_stop_failed: The simulation stopped, but its history could not be saved: {error}
game_sim.history_rollback_failed: The simulation could not be fully rolled back: {error}
game_sim.no_active_process: No active simulated process was found.
game_sim.showing_top: Showing top {count} games. Search to find more.

account.select_desc: Found multiple valid Discord tokens. Please select which account to use:

dialog.accept_quests_desc: Accept {count} quests? This action will enroll you in these quests.
dialog.complete_quests_desc: Add {count} video quests to the completion queue? This will process them one by one.
dialog.complete_game_desc: Add {count} game quests to the completion queue? This will process them one by one.
dialog.complete_all_desc: Add {count} quests to the completion queue? This will process them one by one.
dialog.activity_excluded_notice: Activity quests require manual interaction and will not be auto-completed.

debug.title: Debug Information
debug.description: View program parameters and configuration values
debug.super_properties_desc: Request header properties sent to Discord API
debug.runner_desc: Game simulation runner binary embedded in the application
debug.running_games_desc: Read the raw game detector state and native executable fingerprints through CDP. This is read-only.
debug.running_games_empty: No games were returned, or Discord has not loaded RunningGameStore in the selected target.
debug.captured_headers_desc: Intercept all Discord client HTTP requests via CDP Network and collect header statistics
debug.capture_hint: Requires Discord running with debug flag. Click Capture to collect all HTTP request headers for the specified duration.
debug.request_no_match: No requests match the current filter.
debug.decoder_desc: Decode base64-encoded x-super-properties header to view the JSON payload.
debug.header_profile_desc: Resolved request identity and locale headers used by API calls.
debug.quest_api_baseline_desc: Observed Quest-related endpoints from the current CDP network capture.
debug.quest_api_baseline_empty: Capture headers from Discord with CDP to populate the Quest API baseline.
debug.quest_placement_decisions_desc: Fetches diagnostics only. Does not affect the main quest list.

sidebar.orbs_unavailable: Unable to load Orbs. Try refreshing.

toast.stream_quest_desc: Stream quests require you to stream the game on Discord manually. Start a stream in a voice channel, then use the Game Simulator to simulate the game.

game_idle.navigation_locked: Game idle is running. Stop it before leaving this page.
game_idle.title: Keep games and apps rotating
game_idle.description: Choose random candidates or build an ordered playlist, with a fixed simulation duration and optional rest after each item.
game_idle.sign_in_required: Sign in to start and record account history.
game_idle.play_minutes_error: Play time must be a positive whole number.
game_idle.rest_minutes_error: Rest time must be zero or a positive whole number.
game_idle.queue_label: Current and upcoming games and apps
game_idle.ready_description: Choose candidates, simulation mode and duration. Upcoming items appear when idle mode starts.
game_idle.playlist_help: Runs in order and repeats. Saved automatically on this device; stop idle mode to edit.
game_idle.playlist_empty_error: Add at least one game or app.
game_idle.playlist_unavailable_error: Some playlist items are unavailable. Remove them or switch simulation mode.
game_idle.search_limit: Showing {count} of {total}. Search to narrow the results.
game_idle.catalog_error: Could not load the catalog. Try refreshing.
game_idle.persistence_error: Idle settings could not be saved. Changes may be lost after restarting.
game_idle.crash_simulation_desc: Randomly close the current game during rotation and reopen it after a short delay, simulating a disconnect.
game_idle.crash_simulation_error: Crash delay must be a positive whole number and the reopen delay zero or positive.

desktop_clients.ask_each_time_desc: Ask which installed client to start whenever CDP is unavailable.
desktop_clients.auto_desc: Let Helper attach to an existing Discord-ready endpoint or choose the first available supported client.
desktop_clients.owner_conflict_title: Another desktop client owns this CDP port
desktop_clients.owner_conflict_desc: Use the client already connected to this port, switch to the selected client, or cancel and choose another port.
desktop_clients.restore_all_and_close: Confirm external clients, restore all, and close

exit_cdp.restore_and_close: Close app and restart Discord normally
exit_cdp.helper_error: The Discord restart helper could not be started. You may need to fully quit and reopen Discord manually.

global_quests.description: Browse all unexpired quests from the community catalog, including regional variants.
global_quests.country_hint: Country filtering includes global quests and excludes unknown availability.
global_quests.refresh_error: Refresh failed. Showing the previous catalog.
global_quests.regions_stale: Restriction data could not be updated. Previous information is retained.
global_quests.regions_error: Restriction data is unavailable. Missing information is shown as unknown.
global_quests.account_error: Account completion status could not be updated.
global_quests.load_error: Could not load the quest catalog.
global_quests.empty: No quests match your search and filters.
global_quests.age_hint: Age verification may be required for this quest.
global_quests.eligibility_hint: Community restriction labels do not guarantee eligibility for your account.

discord_console.description: Run JavaScript in the connected Discord client and view live output.
discord_console.disabled_description: Enable the console to start receiving and displaying Discord client logs.
discord_console.empty: Run a command to get started. Discord logs appear here in real time.
discord_console.shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd+Enter: execute · Enter: new line · Alt+↑/↓: history
